label: Elevation
description: Ground height above sea level at the hex centre.
source: Copernicus GLO-90 DEM via Open-Meteo Elevation API

label: Slope
description: Steepest gradient from this hex to any neighbouring hex.

label: Mean annual temperature
description: Mean of hourly 2 m air temperature over the year, lapse-rate corrected to hex elevation.

label: Summer daily maximum
description: Mean daily maximum temperature in June–August, lapse-rate corrected.

label: Wet-bulb temperature (99th percentile)
description: 99th percentile of hourly wet-bulb temperature (Stull 2011): the design point for evaporative cooling.

label: Free-cooling hours
description: Hours per year with dry-bulb temperature below 18 °C, when air-side economisers can cool a data hall without chillers.

label: Mean relative humidity
description: Mean hourly relative humidity at 2 m.

label: Mean wind speed
description: Mean hourly 10 m wind speed.

label: Solar irradiance
description: Annual global horizontal irradiance (sum of hourly shortwave radiation).

label: Wind speed at 100 m
description: Mean hourly wind speed at a typical turbine hub height (100 m).

label: Wind power density
description: Mean available wind power per m² of rotor at 100 m (0.5·ρ·v³): what a turbine can actually harvest.

label: Annual precipitation
description: Mean yearly rainfall total over the normals period.

label: Soil moisture
description: Mean volumetric soil water content in the top 7 cm over the normals period (drainage, foundations, vegetation).

label: Reference evapotranspiration
description: FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration per year: water demand of vegetation and evaporative cooling.

label: Warming trend
description: Linear trend of annual mean temperature over the normals period (historical warming rate).

label: Population density
description: Residents per km² from the WorldPop 100 m constrained grid (or ONS Census 2021 LSOAs when those files are present).
source: WorldPop 2020 constrained 100 m (CC BY 4.0); optional ONS Census 2021 TS001 by LSOA

label: Residential land
description: Fraction of the hex covered by landuse=residential (from 7 sample points per hex).

label: Crime rate
description: Street-level crimes recorded in the hex over 12 months per 1,000 residents. Centres with high footfall and few residents (e.g. the West End) score high.
source: data.police.uk street-level crime (Metropolitan + City of London police)

label: Deprivation
description: Index of Multiple Deprivation score of the LSOAs in and around the hex (higher = more deprived).
source: MHCLG English Indices of Deprivation (File 7, LSOA) + ONS LSOA centroids

label: Median house price
description: Median sale price of residential transactions in the hex over the last 12 months (gaps filled from neighbours).
source: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data + ONS Postcode Directory (postcode centroids)

label: Flood risk
description: Weighted share of the hex in Environment Agency Flood Zone 3 (1.0) or Zone 2 (0.5). Zones ignore defences such as the Thames Barrier.
source: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning via planning.data.gov.uk (flood-risk-zone)

label: Flood Zone 3
description: 1 if at least half of the hex lies in EA Flood Zone 3 (≥1% annual river / 0.5% sea risk), else 0.
source: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning via planning.data.gov.uk (flood-risk-zone)

label: Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)
description: Annual mean surface NO₂ concentration.

label: Fine particulates (PM2.5)
description: Annual mean surface PM2.5 concentration.

label: Grid carbon intensity
description: Mean forecast carbon intensity of electricity for the distribution region. All of Greater London is one region (London, id 13), so this layer is uniform here; it differentiates sites once a region spans several DNOs.
source: National Grid ESO Carbon Intensity API (regional)

label: Distance to station
description: Straight-line distance from the hex centre to the nearest station or Underground entrance.

label: Distance to HV substation
description: Distance to the nearest substation tagged ≥ 132 kV (falls back to all mapped substations if voltages are missing). Large loads need a grid connection here.

label: Distance to HV line
description: Distance to the nearest mapped transmission line (power=line) or HV cable.
source: OpenStreetMap power=line, power=cable via Overpass API

label: Distance to internet exchange
description: Distance to the nearest interconnection hub hosting LINX/LONAP (Docklands, City, Slough).
source: Seeded list of public London IXP facilities (approximate coordinates; see layers/_places.py)

label: Distance to water
description: Distance to the nearest river, canal, reservoir or lake (cooling / process water access).
source: OpenStreetMap natural=water, waterway=river|canal via Overpass API

label: Distance to park
description: Distance from the hex centre to the edge of the nearest public park (0 inside a park). Lower = better access.

label: Distance to major road
description: Distance to the nearest motorway, trunk or primary road (access for heavy vehicles; also noise and pollution).

label: Distance to primary school
description: Distance from the hex centre to the nearest open primary school.
source: DfE Get Information About Schools (GIAS); OpenStreetMap amenity=school as fallback

label: Distance to secondary school
description: Distance from the hex centre to the nearest open secondary school.
source: DfE Get Information About Schools (GIAS); OpenStreetMap amenity=school as fallback

label: Good schools nearby
description: Percentage of Ofsted-rated schools within 2 km of the hex centre rated Good or Outstanding.
source: DfE Get Information About Schools (GIAS) with latest Ofsted overall effectiveness

label: Protected land
description: 1 if at least half of the hex is Green Belt, an SSSI or a nature reserve, else 0.

label: Cloud cover
description: Mean daily total cloud cover (2016–2025); cloudier sites lose solar yield.

label: Distance to airport
description: Straight-line distance from the hex centre to the nearest aerodrome (aeroway=aerodrome); nuclear siting keeps clear of aircraft crash hazard and airspace constraints.

label: Seismic activity
description: Number of USGS ComCat earthquakes of magnitude ≥ 3.0 within 150 km of the hex over the last 50 years — a proxy for seismic hazard at the site.
source: USGS ComCat earthquake catalogue (FDSN event API)

label: Sunshine hours
description: Mean yearly hours of bright sunshine (2016–2025), the direct driver of solar PV yield.

label: Peak wind gusts
description: Mean of each year's strongest 10 m gust (2016–2025); extreme loads for turbines and panels.
